Behance and Adobe Firefly FAQ Updated 2 years ago Was Behance content used to train Adobe Firefly?
No, Behance content was not used for training the first model of Firefly.
Can I post AI-generated art to Behance?
Yes, you can share AI-generated art projects to Behance.
All projects, including generative art projects, must follow our community guidelines and the Behance Terms of Use .
How do I know a project was made with generative AI models?
We encourage all projects, including those made with Generative AI, to be tagged and labeled with the tools used to create them.
You can add and edit tags and tools in your project settings when creating a Behance project.
Additionally, we are exploring automated ways to detect and tag work created using generative AI models.
We currently support and will expand the use of Content Credentials throughout Behance to help provide provenance and transparency about the origins of content.
